## 🧪 Plunder v{{VERSION}}

This is an official release of Plunder, a romsite scraper and frontend for the **Trimui Smart Pro** handheld.  
It works on both the **stock OS** and **[CrossMix OS](https://github.com/cizia64/CrossMix-OS)**.  

{{NOTES}}

### 📥 Installation  
1. Download the attached build.  
2. Unzip the file.  
3. Place the **Plunder** folder into:  SDCARD/Apps/

Already on Plunder v2.0.0 or newer? Use **Settings → Check for Updates** on the device instead.
